items.title_en: Flyer hits IndiGo Pilot announcing flight delay due to dense fog conditions, video goes viral
items.title_zh: 传单击中靛蓝航空飞行员宣布由于大雾天气航班延误，视频疯传
items.summary_en: Passenger assaults IndiGo flight pilot during delay announcement; safety concerns for airline staff amid extended delays; passenger's actions widely condemned on social media.
items.summary_zh: 乘客在延误通知期间袭击靛蓝航空飞行员；航空公司工作人员因长时间延误而面临的安全问题；乘客的行为在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责。
